mapper.select: SELECT CONCAT_WS( '-', t1.`code`, t1.`name` ) FROM bp_equipment_info AS t1 JOIN bp_equipment_station_info AS t2 ON t1.id = t2.equipment_id WHERE t1.is_deleted = 0 AND t2.is_deleted = 0 AND t2.station_id = #{id}

SELECT DISTINCT info.equipment_id FROM bp_equipment_station_user AS users JOIN bp_equipment_station_info AS info ON users.station_id = info.station_id WHERE users.is_deleted = 0 AND info.is_deleted = 0 AND users.user_id =#{userId}

SELECT station.* FROM bp_equipment_station AS station JOIN bp_equipment_station_info AS info ON station.id = info.station_id WHERE station.is_deleted = 0 AND info.is_deleted = 0 AND station.`enable` = '1' AND info.equipment_id = #{id}
